ReactOS 0.4.17-x86-dev Setup




      Welcome to ReactOS Setup


      This part of the setup copies the ReactOS Operating System to your
      computer and prepares the second part of the setup.


           Press ENTER to install or upgrade ReactOS.

           Press R to repair a ReactOS installation.

           Press L to view the ReactOS Licensing Terms and Conditions.

           Press F3 to quit without installing ReactOS.

      For more information on ReactOS, please visit:
      https://reactos.org/
























   ENTER = Continue  R = Repair  L = License  F3 = Quit

ReactOS 0.4.17-x86-dev Setup




      ReactOS Version Status


      ReactOS is in Alpha stage, meaning it is not feature-complete
      and is under heavy development. It is recommended to use it only for
      evaluation and testing purposes and not as your daily-usage OS.

      Backup your data or test on a secondary computer if you attempt
      to run ReactOS on real hardware.


           Press ENTER to continue ReactOS Setup.

           Press F3 to quit without installing ReactOS.



























   ENTER = Continue   F3 = Quit

ReactOS 0.4.17-x86-dev Setup




      The list below shows the current device settings.


               Computer: ACPI PC Uniprocessor
                Display: VESA Display (800x600x32)
               Keyboard: XT-, AT- or extended keyboard (83-105 keys)
        Keyboard layout: English (USA)

                 Accept: Accept these device settings


      You can change the hardware settings by pressing the UP or DOWN keys
      to select an entry. Then press the ENTER key to select alternative
      settings.

      When all settings are correct, select "Accept these device settings"
      and press ENTER.
























   ENTER = Continue   F3 = Quit

ReactOS 0.4.17-x86-dev Setup




      The list below shows existing partitions and unused disk
      space for new partitions.

           Press UP or DOWN to select a list entry.

           Press ENTER to install ReactOS onto the selected partition.

           Press C to create a primary/logical partition.

           Press E to create an extended partition.

           Press D to delete an existing partition.


    1024 MB Harddisk 0 (Port=0, Bus=0, Id=0) [RAW]

             Unpartitioned space                1023 MB
























   ENTER = Install   C = Create Primary   E = Create Extended   F3 = Quit

      Setup created a new partition on
